I truly enjoyed the delightful food 🍲 and the beautiful decor creates a wonderful atmosphere. The staff provided exceptional service, even interacting playfully with the children! ✨ It’s a bit pricier than usual, but ideal for special occasions like birthdays 🎂 or anniversaries, as they decorate in advance. A lovely experience! 😊 …
